description: Na₂HfZnP₂SO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.93 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.93 Å. Hf is bonded to six O atoms to form HfO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Hf-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.16 Å. Zn is bonded to six O atoms to form ZnO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Zn-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.25 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent HfO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent ZnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-37°. There are two shorter (1.51 Å) and two longer (1.59 Å) P-O bond lengths. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent HfO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent ZnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 17-37°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.58 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent HfO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent ZnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-36°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.50 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Zn and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Zn and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zn, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na, one Hf, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Hf and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Hf and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zn, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Zn, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Zn, and one S atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Hf, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Hf, and one S atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Hf, and one P atom.
